gaps: A la derecha de la pagina hay una captura de un guion de Scratch: bloques apilados que empiezan por 'when [bandera verde] clicked' y contienen cuatro bloques 'repeat' anidados, cada uno con una llamada a un sub-programa y un bloque 'move 40 steps'. Solo se transcriben las etiquetas de los bloques, no su disposicion ni los colores.
El icono de la bandera verde dentro del bloque 'when ... clicked' es un dibujo, no texto.

spans.text: Unit 6: Sub-routines in programming
Let’s convert the algorithm above to Scratch code:
Open a new project.
Choose the Pencil sprite.
Create the Draw Triangle sub-routine for the sprite.
Select Make a block from the My Blocks palette and name it Draw Triangle.
Add pen down from the Pen palette. Note if the Pen palette is not shown select it from the Add Extension icon.
Select the Repeat 10 block from the Control palette and change 10 to 3.
Add the Move 10 steps from the Motions palette and change 10 to 30.
Add the turn left 15 degrees from the Motions palette and change 15 to 120.
Add pen up from the Pen palette.
Create the Draw Square sub-routine for the sprite.
Select Make a block from the My Blocks palette and name it Draw Square.
Add pen down from the Pen palette.
Select the Repeat 10 block from the Control palette and change 10 to 4.
Add the Move 10 steps from the Motions palette and change 10 to 30.
Add the turn left 15 degrees from the Motions palette and change 15 to 90.
Add pen up from the Pen palette.
Let’s create the code to match the algorithm name: Pattern.
Add the When green flag clicked from the Control palette.
Select the Repeat 10 block from the Control palette and change 10 to 3.
Add the Draw Triangle sub-routine from the My Blocks palette.
Add the Move 10 steps from the Motions palette and change 10 to 40.
Select the Repeat 10 block from the Control palette and change 10 to 3.
Add the Draw Square sub-routine from the My Blocks palette.
when clicked
repeat 3
Draw Triangle
move 40 steps
repeat 3
Draw Square
move 40 steps
repeat 3
Draw Triangle
move 40 steps
repeat 2
Draw Square
move 40 steps
